Tested with Realtime Compute for Apache Flink (VVR 11.9, Flink 1.20) and the built-in Iceberg connector against a DLF Iceberg REST catalog (cn-hangzhou, 2026-10-15) on format-version 3 tables; results read back with Spark 3.5 / Iceberg 1.10.

links.label: Realtime Compute for Apache Flink - Iceberg connector (supports Iceberg v1 and v2 table formats)

alibaba-realtime-flink:write-insert:v2.notes: Sink table in batch and streaming mode, with write.operation insert (append) or bulk_insert. It is also a target for Flink CDC YAML data ingestion jobs.
caveats: v2 table format requires VVR 8.0.7 or later

alibaba-realtime-flink:write-insert:v3.notes: The connector page lists Iceberg v1/v2 only, but in testing the connector created, read and wrote format-version 3 tables. In testing: INSERT into V3 tables committed snapshots that Spark read back correctly. Tested with Realtime Compute for Apache Flink (VVR 11.9, Flink 1.20) and the built-in Iceberg connector against a DLF Iceberg REST catalog (cn-hangzhou, 2026-10-15) on format-version 3 tables; results read back with Spark 3.5 / Iceberg 1.10.

links.label: Realtime Compute for Apache Flink - Iceberg connector (supports Iceberg v1 and v2 table formats)

alibaba-realtime-flink:write-merge-updat.notes: Row-level changes go only through primary-key upsert writes (default write.operation=upsert). No MERGE INTO / UPDATE / DELETE SQL statements are documented for Iceberg tables.
caveats: v2 table format requires VVR 8.0.7 or later

alibaba-realtime-flink:write-merge-updat.notes: The connector page lists Iceberg v1/v2 only, but in testing the connector created, read and wrote format-version 3 tables. In testing: Row-level changes only via primary-key upsert on V3 tables; SQL DELETE and UPDATE statements failed, and an upsert batch containing the same key twice failed. Tested with Realtime Compute for Apache Flink (VVR 11.9, Flink 1.20) and the built-in Iceberg connector against a DLF Iceberg REST catalog (cn-hangzhou, 2026-10-15) on format-version 3 tables; results read back with Spark 3.5 / Iceberg 1.10.
caveats: No DELETE / UPDATE / MERGE SQL
